mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a growing economy, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with strong housing starts growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an aggressive monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of aggressive easing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate, combined with increasing payroll employment, signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 30% of instances with strong labor market conditions.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production, combined with a decrease in the federal funds rate, signals a growing economy with easing monetary conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of growing industrial production and easing monetary conditions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in real GDP signals a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with strong GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate, combined with increasing consumer price index, signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of tightening monetary conditions and high inflation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate signals a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances with high unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales signals a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of slowing retail sales (t-test p > 0.05).
